description: A round golden bean / ingot mascot wearing a red scarf. Pixel-art desktop pet themed around gold price: idle, price up, price down, target-price alert, watching, waiting, waving, running and alert bell.

animations.name: gold-up
animations.description: 金价上涨：咧嘴大笑、开心蹦跳、冒金币

animations.name: gold-down
animations.description: 金价下跌：垂头丧气、哭丧脸、落泪

animations.name: target-reached
animations.description: 达到设定价提醒：激动跳起、星形闪光、敲铃提醒

animations.name: thinking
animations.description: 盯盘思考：托腮、眯眼盯着前方

animations.name: waiting
animations.description: 等待：无聊发呆、左右张望

animations.name: alert
animations.description: 提醒播报：举铃摇晃、冒金币闪光
